mostWorthwhile.text: Following the rubble world past the giant and then the passing star was most worthwhile: two encounters changed its orbit and ultimately freed it without breaking it.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final ice encounter was the least meaningful choice because it was the only combination left, although its outcome was informative.

surprise.text: The rubble world escaped its sun without being captured by the passing star or broken apart.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless; the final result explained why the ice and rubble world could have different outcomes under the same gravity.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue: following an intact body through successive gravitational encounters made me curious about where it might go next.
